teaser.en: Break open its knobbly green fruit and you find sweet white custard studded with black seeds.
teaser.sw: Pasua tunda lake la kijani lenye vivimbe na utakuta krimu tamu nyeupe iliyojaa mbegu nyeusi.

summary.en: The custard apple is a small homestead tree with scaly, knobbly fruits full of sweet, creamy flesh. It is grown for its fruit, eaten fresh.
summary.sw: Mtomoko ni mti mdogo wa nyumbani wenye matunda ya magamba na vivimbe yaliyojaa nyama tamu kama krimu. Hupandwa kwa ajili ya matunda yake, yanayoliwa mabichi.

about.en:
The custard apple is a small, open tree with thin, alternate leaves that smell faintly aromatic when crushed. Its greenish-yellow flowers have thick, fleshy petals and often hang half-hidden among the leaves.

The fruit is round to heart-shaped and covered in rounded, scale-like segments. When ripe, it softens and the segments begin to separate. Inside is sweet, white, custard-like flesh around many shiny black seeds.
about.sw:
Mtomoko ni mti mdogo ulio wazi wenye majani membamba yanayopishana, yanayotoa harufu nzuri hafifu yakipondwa. Maua yake ya rangi ya kijani-manjano yana petali nene zenye nyama, na mara nyingi huning'inia yakiwa yamejificha nusu katikati ya majani.

Tunda ni la mviringo hadi umbo la moyo na limefunikwa kwa vipande vya mviringo kama magamba. Likiiva hulainika na vipande huanza kuachana. Ndani kuna nyama tamu nyeupe kama krimu inayozunguka mbegu nyingi nyeusi zinazong'aa.

where.en: The custard apple is a homestead tree, planted near houses for its fruit.
where.sw: Mtomoko ni mti wa nyumbani, unaopandwa karibu na nyumba kwa ajili ya matunda yake.

uses.en: The ripe fruit is eaten fresh, the flesh scooped out and the seeds spat out. The seeds should not be eaten, since in this family they are toxic.
uses.sw: Tunda lililoiva huliwa bichi; nyama huchotwa na mbegu hutemwa. Mbegu hazipaswi kuliwa, kwa kuwa katika familia hii zina sumu.

names.en: No Digo name has been recorded yet. Swahili: *mtopetope* or *mtomoko*. English: custard apple or sweetsop. Scientists call it *Annona squamosa*. In the Mgombato dictionary, *mtopetope* is also listed as an equivalent for the wild custard apple, *mbokwe*.
names.sw: Bado hakuna jina la Kidigo lililorekodiwa. Kiswahili: *mtopetope* au *mtomoko*. Kwa Kiingereza: *custard apple* au *sweetsop*. Wanasayansi huuita *Annona squamosa*. Katika kamusi ya Mgombato, *mtopetope* pia umeorodheshwa kama kisawe cha mtomoko mwitu, *mbokwe*.

reason.en: Wild custard apple, a bush relative
reason.sw: Mtomoko mwitu, ndugu yake wa vichakani

reason.en: Fellow member of the custard-apple family
reason.sw: Mwanafamilia mwenzake wa familia ya mitopetope

reason.en: Wild relative with small sweet fruits
reason.sw: Ndugu wa porini mwenye matunda madogo matamu
